summary: Clarified the one-line requirement 'add a validation rule so Opportunity Amount can't go down after Closed Won' at scale ask (D=1 metadata type, S=1 skill with a question table, O=1 object, integration=no). Harvested all 7 rows of admin/validation-rules plus all 7 rows of the generic admin/requirements-gathering-for-sf set, deduped one pair, for 13 clarifications: 7 blocking, 6 informational pre-filled from proposed defaults. Two adjacent Opportunity skills (opportunity-management, sales-process-mapping) surfaced in search and were read but excluded as out of scope. Wrote clarifications[] via set-clarifications, validated, rendered CLARIFICATIONS.md and RUN.md; build is at status clarifying, gate clarifications pending.
confidence_rationale: Every capability phrase returned index hits and every clarification traces to a harvested row or the generic set (HIGH criteria), but 6 of 7 blocking questions carry default_source: none because no honest default exists for org-specific facts on a bare one-line ask with no org connected — more than a quarter of the 13 questions, which is the agent's own MEDIUM threshold.

Once gate clarifications+plan is approved via the scale:ask go alias, build-planner should turn the seven blocking answers into the single M1-S01 validation step per the § 3.1 worked example.
